## ✨ What's new in 0.2.4

### 📂 Drag files from the server straight into Explorer
- Drag files and folders from the **Server** pane of the SFTP panel and drop them into **Windows Explorer**, onto the desktop or into any app that accepts files.
- Nothing is downloaded up front: a file is streamed over SFTP only when Explorer copies it, with Explorer's own progress dialog. Folders keep their structure.
- Dropping on the **Local** pane still downloads into the local folder (hold `Shift` to move). The drop target is now highlighted while you drag.

### 🧭 One dialog for every new host
- A **SSH / SFTP | RDP** switch at the top of the new-host dialog. Switching keeps the address and folder you already entered.

### Good to know
- Dragging out to other apps works on Windows (x64 and ARM64). On macOS, drop the files on the Local pane for now; Finder support is planned.
- Files the server account isn't allowed to read are reported by Explorer as a copy error.
- Explorer copies in the app's window thread, so the window may respond slowly while a very large file is copied.
